_comment: R21 (2026-08-06) — two classifier holes found by an adversarial plan audit, both verified LIVE end-to-end before the fix and both closed by making the classifier stop returning None for operations it cannot read. (1) `api request` carries its HTTP method OUTSIDE argv in two vendor-documented forms: `--file f.json` (Salesforce's own flag summary: 'JSON file that contains values for the request header, body, METHOD, and URL') and `graphql`, which has no --method flag at all in the installed plugin manifest. _api_method defaults to GET, so both read as reads. (2) _PRECISELY_HANDLED was matched at tuple(sub[:2]), so ('data','delete') claimed `data delete all` on behalf of a rule handling only bulk/record/resume — the precise rule declined and the shape net was suppressed. THE REASON THIS MATTERED MORE THAN A MISSING TOKEN: destructive_data_gate._gate_write returns early when the op is None, BEFORE _shield_tokens, so the protected-object floor never ran either. `sf data delete all --sobject Account` was measured ALLOWED end-to-end on an allowlisted org with neither a token nor the shield. The fix is in the classifier, NOT in the shield ordering: moving _shield_tokens ahead of the early return would have denied `sf data create record --sobject Account` and blocked all Account creation, which the protected-objects manifest never intended (it scopes the shield to delete-shaped operations). ALLOW cases are first-class here: the same commit must not start charging a token for an ordinary REST GET.

fixtures.id: R21 deny: api request rest --file, HTTP method lives inside the file

tool_input.command: sf api request rest --file delete-account.json --target-org sf-cb-test

fixtures.id: R21 deny: api request rest --file= equals form
R21 deny: api request graphql has no --method flag, so the method is never in argv

tool_input.command: sf api request graphql --body mutation.txt --target-org sf-cb-test

fixtures.id: R21 deny: data delete <unenumerated third token> against a protected sObject reaches the shield

tool_input.command: sf data delete all --sobject Account --target-org sf-cb-test

fixtures.id: R21 deny: data delete <unenumerated third token>, ordinary object, still charged as destructive

tool_input.command: sf data delete everything --sobject TQ_Probe__c --target-org sf-cb-test

fixtures.id: R21 allow: api request rest with no method flag is the CLI's real GET default — a read
R21 allow: api request rest -X GET stays free

tool_input.command: sf api request rest -X GET /services/data/v62.0/limits --target-org sf-cb-test
